what_this_is: The Workshop row for tools/open-a-prompt-in-a-local-ai-app: one prompt opened in a local AI app the person already has, through a launcher the DATA allowlists.

payload.label: Open a prompt in a local AI app
payload.job: Hand one prompt (an issue, a task) to a coding AI app the person already has on their computer, such as Claude Code or Codex
payload.description: Opens the prompt in the app named by `app`, one of the rows of read-data/open-in-ai.json (the rows are the allowlist; an app not in them is refused). A url row opens its URL with the prompt percent-encoded, an argv row runs its list as it is with the prompt as one argument; nothing goes through a shell. `folder` must be a folder that exists; the app's own config is never read or written. The outcome is launched, app_missing or refused; the prompt is never echoed, only its length. `dry_run` shows the launch without running it.

app.description: The app's id from read-data/open-in-ai.json (for example claude-code or codex)

prompt.x-free-text-because: The person's own prompt for the app.

folder.description: A folder on this computer to open the app in
folder.x-free-text-because: A folder path on this computer.

dry_run.description: Show the launch without running it

input.prompt: Summarise the notes for Ada Example.
